title: Implement BFCL-style tool suite
summary: 实现 BFCL 风格工具调用评估，包括 simple、multiple、parallel 和 irrelevance case。
requirement: Implement a BFCL-style benchmark suite with structured tool-call scoring for tool selection, argument matching, parallel calls, and irrelevant-tool rejection.
acceptance: suite covers simple, multiple, parallel, and irrelevance families
tool selection and argument scoring are deterministic
case results preserve tool-call evidence and score breakdown
